previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma with CNS involvement, was admitted electively for maintenance rituximab and high-dose methotrexate chemotherapy. He tolerated the treatment well without significant adverse events. Aggressive hydration and urinary alkalinization were used to prevent renal toxicity, and leucovorin rescue was administered until methotrexate levels dropped below 0.1 µM. A brain MRI showed no evidence of disease recurrence. His home aspirin was held during treatment to support urine alkalization and safely restarted at discharge. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to manage nausea if needed and avoid sun exposure.

diffusion abnormalities are detected.  Major arterial flow voids are
preserved.

IMPRESSION:  No evidence of disease recurrence.
